description.value: Eden Bento Café is a Japanese restaurant in Kamloops serving sushi, bento boxes, sashimi, donburi, poke bowls, and more from a retail unit on Lansdowne Street. It offers a notably broad Japanese menu spanning nigiri, specialty rolls, noodles, and party trays, with online ordering available for convenient pickup. A solid mid-ride refuelling stop in central Kamloops for cyclists craving Japanese food.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 51m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms the business name, address (450 Lansdowne St #223, Kamloops, BC V2C 1Y4), and phone number ((778) 471-7072), all consistent with OSM tags. The site emphasizes online ordering and a broad Japanese menu (sushi, bento, donburi, poke bowls), confirming it is a real, open restaurant. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags; takeout is clearly supported by the online ordering system.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag lists Tuesday–Saturday, but the website states Monday–Saturday (closed Sunday) — a one-day discrepancy that may need correcting in OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open Japanese restaurant in central Kamloops with an active website and confirmed contact details; a practical food stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: sushi, bento boxes, sashimi, donburi, poke bowls
